snippet.title: Five Nights at Leon's l Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello everyone my name is Omar and I made my first game on clickteam fusion and this is the first trailer for it not the best but I tried, this is my first time btw. This project took six months from me to make so I hope this game might be enjoyable for some you. its not the best fan game out there since its just similar to fnaf and its my first game so it might not be that perfect, but I hope some of you might like it :P
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Here is the link the for it: https://gamejolt.com/games/7821193/243318
Also the link for the Remastered version: https://gamejolt.com/games/FNaLR/452577
